Subject: SolaceWare onboarding packet — initial intake

Hi Olga / Monica,

Thanks for the quick intake call this morning. Attached is the completed onboarding form and a first‑pass PO request spreadsheet (SW_PO_Request_v2.xlsx). We included the contract summary and the signed SOW stub for your records.

A few notes up front:
- We requested an initial spend cap of $120,000 based on expected usage for Q1.
- Line table A has monthly support broken out; line 3 is a hardware add‑on that we flagged in the SOW.

Can you confirm the expected PO prefix/format and any additional fields Procurement needs so our AP team can match invoices later?

Attachments: [SolaceWare_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF, 212KB)], [SW_PO_Request_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 34KB)], [Signed_SOW_stub.pdf (PDF, 87KB)]

Best,
Lisa

Thanks Lisa — received. Monica, tagging you to drive PO issuance and confirm the spend cap. Two quick asks:

1) Can Procurement issue a provisional PO (we typically use prefix SW‑YYYY‑####) so the vendor can start the onboarding tasks?
2) Please validate the line items in the attached spreadsheet; AP will need SKU codes and unit price granularity for matching.

Karthik — FYI, SolaceWare asked for an early ramp. If we can get a provisional PO today it helps scheduling the kickoff.

— Olga

Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SolaceWare onboarding packet — provisional PO issued (SW-2026-1042)

Olga / Karthik / Lisa —

I issued a provisional PO this morning: SW‑2026‑1042, spend cap set to $120,000 as requested. The provisional PO is marked 'Provisional — do not invoice past cap'. I attached the PO request export (SW_PO_Request_v2.xlsx) with the PO number populated.

Action items for the vendor before we finalize:
- Please confirm all SKU codes (column SKU_ID) and unit prices for each line so AP can validate invoices.
- Confirm whether the hardware add‑on on line 3 should be quantity 2 or 20 — the intake form and SOW show different numbers.

If the vendor confirms the quantity increase, we will need to open a spend cap amendment.

Attachments: [SW_PO_Request_v2.xlsx (updated, XSLX, 38KB)]

— Monica
Procurement Analyst | Redwood Inference
From: Lisa Moreno <lisa.moreno@solaceware.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SolaceWare onboarding packet — provisional PO issued (SW-2026-1042)

Thanks Monica — quick clarification from our side after reviewing the exported sheet:

- Good catch on line 3. The SOW is correct: the hardware add‑on should be quantity 2 (the intake form had a typo of 20).
- SKU mismatch on line 5: we referenced SKU 'SW‑NET‑LT' in the intake form but the AP system expects 'SW‑NET‑LT‑V2'.
- Unit price on line 7 is net of a 3% early payment discount; if Redwood prefers gross pricing for PO matching, we can present both gross/net columns.

I've attached a corrected SW_PO_Request_v2_corrected.xlsx and the signed SOW stub again. Please use the corrected file for the final PO issuance.

Attachments: [SW_PO_Request_v2_corrected.xlsx (XLSX, 29KB)], [Signed_SOW_stub.pdf (PDF, 87KB)]

Let me know if you want us to reformat the sheet to include both gross and net prices — we can do that this afternoon.

— Lisa
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Moreno <lisa.moreno@solaceware.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SolaceWare onboarding packet — PO reissue plan and spend cap amendment

Great — thanks for the fast turn, Lisa. Monica: please reissue the PO using the corrected spreadsheet and update the PO number if needed. Because the SOW total with corrected quantities and the early‑pay discount reconciliation pushes the worst‑case exposure slightly above the current provisional cap, recommend we provisionally increase the spend cap to $125,000 and note a required approval checkpoint at $120,000 usage. That gives ops the buffer to kick off onboarding without breaking approval gates.

I've opened a procurement ticket: PROC‑4821 (link above) to track the reissue + finance approval. Action summary:
- Monica: reissue corrected PO (final PO or new SW‑2026‑1042 revision) and attach corrected spreadsheet.
- Monica & Finance: validate gross vs net columns for AP match rules; confirm invoice match fields (SKU_ID, PO line#, unit_price).
- Lisa: confirm whether you'd prefer gross pricing on the PO or to keep net with a separate discount line.

If all agree, we'll close out this thread once the final PO is in the system. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

— Olga
Director, Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference
